functions.description: Calcula el número de estudiantes activos en un aula
functions.logic: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM classroom_students WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id
functions.performance: Considerar materializar vista si se usa frecuentemente
functions.sql: CREATE FUNCTION count_classroom_students(p_classroom_id UUID) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM classroom_students WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

functions.description: Calcula el número de módulos asignados a un aula
functions.logic: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT module_id) FROM classroom_modules WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id
functions.sql: CREATE FUNCTION count_classroom_modules(p_classroom_id UUID) RETURNS INTEGER AS $$ BEGIN RETURN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT module_id) FROM classroom_modules WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

functions.description: Valida que el aula no exceda el límite de 100 estudiantes
functions.logic: Retorna true si el aula tiene menos de 100 estudiantes
functions.sql: CREATE FUNCTION validate_classroom_student_limit(p_classroom_id UUID) RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$ BEGIN RETURN (SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM classroom_students WHERE classroom_id = p_classroom_id) < 100; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
